title: Western Star custom Road Train FUPS Bullbar #12
description: Western Star Road Train spec high tensile aluminium Bullbar for 4800 / 4900 series trucks. Mammoth style bar built with 88mm diameter pipe but 100mm also available. Cow catcher with four small uprights, powder coated silver. Optional other colours available on request. Extra top pipe and optional reversible road train signs and oversize signs and number plate bracket on pipe. Heavy duty tow pin and heavy duty steel backing plate. All 3 main pipes are one piece passing through the drilled extended uprights.
